text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Heeeey, knock knock! What's up,
Trainer? Let's
partyyy!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Palmer suddenly barges into my
office.
Nice Nature and several others
file in one after
the other behind her.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Apologies for the sudden intrusion, but
we're all
getting together to throw a
holiday party.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Would you like to join us?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
It'd also be great if we could use your
office while
we're at it!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Uh oh, looks like your trainer's at a loss
for words.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Um, the reason things came to this is
because...

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
What?! Your family doesn't celebrate
the holidays
together, Sato?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
No, we don't. Both Mother and Father
are always
busy with work and charity
events over the
holidays.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I attend the parties my family's clients
invite us
to, and we hold a party for the
entire Satono
Group as well, but...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: We don't celebrate together as a family.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
For real? Not getting presents must
suck!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Oh, but I do receive presents! Santa
always visits
in the night and leaves gifts
in my stocking!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I've never had an intimate party at home
like you
see in the movies, though, so I
do wonder what
it's like...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Then let's have one!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Huh?!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
That's a good suggestion. We may not
be able to
invite your parents, but we
could throw a party
together.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
We do know a thing or two when it
comes to cozy
little house parties, don't
we? I say we have one!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Yaaay! Parrrrrtyyy!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Oh! Since your parents can't make it,
why don't
we invite your trainer?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Tannhauser with the dope idea! Let's go
now!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
That's the situation. So would you like to
join us...
and also kindly allow us to use
your office?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
You're really okay with it?! Thank you so
much!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
In that case, let's begin putting up
decorations.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Whew... That should do it.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Wow! This is amazing! I had no idea
handmade
decorations could be so
gorgeous!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: I'm baaack! I bought us food and snacks!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Ooh, chicken and pizza! ☆ Wahey!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Evening, everyone!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Huh? Kita?!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, I ran into Tannhauser by the
school gates,
and she invited me over!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
We'd love to have you with us! Come on
in!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Come to think of it, these are all the
same people
who organized the
welcome party for us when we
were new
students!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: You're right! How nostalgic!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Aw... I can't believe how much all the
wide-eyed
newbies have grown...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, yeah, we can take a trip down
memory lane
later! Let's tuck in before
the food gets cold!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Pizza, salad, chicken... squid jerky,
stingray fin,
and vinegared kelp?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Interesting... So is this the standard fare
people
have at house parties?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
It's not exactly standard, but I can't
deny that we
always stock up on these
kind of snacks at our
house over the
winter holidays!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, the shopkeepers gave me a bunch
of
freebies. Looks like they threw in lots
of different
snacks! Isn't that nice!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I'm out! Now it's down to either Kita or
Turbo!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Let's see... Maybe I should pick the
rightmost
card...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Or maybe the left card is better...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Okay, I'm going with the one on the left!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
No, no, no, nooo! I won't let you take
the left
card!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Give it up, Turbo. You're way too easy
to read...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Time passes in a flash, and we have a
wonderful
holiday party.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Satono Diamond and Kitasan Black stay
behind
to help clean up, and I see them
off to their dorm
afterwards.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Hehe, today was so much fun!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I always thought of the holidays as just
another
busy time filled with work, to be
honest.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
That makes sense. You did say you
always have a
bunch of obligations at
the end of the year.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
That's right. It would be nice to invite my
little
brother to a party like today's as
well.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Oh, good idea! I'm sure he'd love it! Let's
throw
another party next year!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Would you be open to joining us again
next year
as well, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Really? You promise?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
It's decided, then! You already have
plans with
me, so don't you dare
double-book yourself!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I make sure to write down my plans for a
party
with Satono Diamond into to my
otherwise empty
schedule for next year.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
All right. I'd say it's about time for some
cake.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Uh-oh! I... I forgot to buy a cake!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Satono Diamond and I pop out to buy
some cake,
but all the nearby stores are
sold out, so we have
to travel a bit
farther for one.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
The winter illuminations sure are
beautiful.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. I've always wanted to walk
through festive
streets like the ones in
the movies.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Of course, that's not to say I dislike
working or
helping at charity events with
my parents.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I always learn a lot at those events, and
I'm proud
to volunteer my time.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
It's just, I've always yearned for a
stereotypical
holiday experience...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
But... everyone is waiting for us to bring
a cake
back.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, you're right. There's no way they'll
have
gotten through them all already!
choice_data_list: お菓子がたくさんあったから大丈夫

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Let's take our time and enjoy the
scenery.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Seeing the streets dressed in seasonal

decorations almost makes it feel like
we're in a
different country, doesn't it?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
It reminds me of a town I strolled
through on a
trip abroad many years
ago.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Someday... I'd like to walk along the
streets in
another country with you.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: What do you think?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I was quite forceful when I selected you
as my
trainer.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
That's why I'd like to know what you
really think
this time.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Would you consider going overseas with
me?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Hehe.
choice_data_list: 君が望んでくれるのなら、行くよ
貴方が望んでくれるのなら、行くよ

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I'm glad to hear you say that! Here's to
many
more happy days working
together.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Let's walk through the streets of an
entirely
different country someday!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As we stare out at the transformed and
magical
town around us, Satono
Diamond and I make a
promise for the
not-so-distant future.
